agents.instructions: Use the original job's input/output paths. Inspect input files. Use files.csv_summary for exact totals. Create the requested briefing and draft follow-ups in the output file. Only finish after files.write and files.read verify that output. Never send messages.

Save a morning briefing to reports/morning.txt with the unpaid order IDs, customer names, exact total, and a short friendly draft follow-up for each overdue unpaid customer. Do not contact anyone. Read the saved report to verify it before finishing.
